metadata.description: Govern existing coding-agent teams without replacing their runtime: explicit ownership, maker/checker separation, workflow gates, evidence, human-held irreversible decisions, and bounded organization evolution. Adopt an existing repository in one command and project the same neutral organization onto Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: orgforge-plugin
plugins.description: 既存のClaude Code運用へ、明示的なownership、maker/checker分離、非スキップのSDLC gate、evidence ledger、人間が保持する不可逆判断を追加するgovernance layer。/org-adoptで途中のrepositoryへ1コマンド導入でき、既存ledgerは追記履歴を保持したまま移行する。通常の開発はtrusted developer modeで進める一方、production credential・deploy・資金・外部公開の保護はhost platformのapprovalとcustodyが担う。
